test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement

**Statement:**

Music is very good for peace of mind.

**Conclusions:**

I. Arijit Singh has a good voice.

Il. Kishor Kumar was a famous singer.
solution:
**Explanation : **

Conclusion I. Arijit Singh has a good voice. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] False (This does not follow as statement is talking about peace of mind which music gives and there is no relation between statement and conclusion)

Conclusion II. Kishor Kumar was a famous singer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] False (This also does not follow as kishore kumar is a famous singer but it does not relate with peace of mind.)

Hence, **Neither of the conclusion follows** is the correct answer.
